text:
Lena Park: Heads up, I merged a tiny logging config flip (toggles debug sampling) to main. No behavioral change but artifacts will differ. Do we bump patch or keep semver stable?

Jordan Miles: If it's purely telemetry/log-level and doesn't touch public API or binary layout, we prefer not to bump the public semver. But we need a way to record the pipeline run so downstream systems see an identifier.

Diego Alvarez: Agreed. We've had infra that expects a distinct tag for cache invalidation. Two options: bump patch (v1.12.4) or emit a buildmeta-only tag (v1.12.3+meta.20260322). I favor buildmeta-only to avoid changing semver history.

releasebot: analysis: diff-classification=config-only; tests=unit+integration passed; suggested-action=emit-buildmeta-tag-if-requested; last-release=v1.12.3.

Lena Park: How will ops handle rollbacks if we only add buildmeta tags? Do our rollback scripts treat buildmeta as part of the version?

ops-bot: rollout-policy=canary(5% for 10m) by default; auto-rollback-triggers=error-rate>2% OR p95_latency>50% ; tag-handling=strip-buildmeta=false (legacy) ; recommended=standardize-strip-behavior.

Jordan Miles: There's the rub: some consumers strip buildmeta and some don't. We need a convention: treat +... as opaque metadata and have all infra tools either consistently strip it or include it. Otherwise metadata-only tags are useless.

Diego Alvarez: Proposal: adopt the following ops/contrib convention and add to RELEASE_PROCESS.md:
- default: config-only changes do not increment semver
- when a distinct artifact is required by downstream pinning, PR author adds annotation `release: metadata-patch`
- releasebot will then create a buildmeta-only tag `v<MAJOR>.<MINOR>.<PATCH>+meta.<YYYYMMDDHHMMSS>`
- only create a plain semver tag (no buildmeta) when behavioral/API change occurs or when downstream explicitly requests a public semver bump

Lena Park: That sounds good. A couple of followups: who is responsible for tagging (CI or maintainers)? And should we put a short changelog entry for meta-only tags?

releasebot: tagging-mode=CI-created-tag-by-default; maintainer-override=allowed; changelog-entry=optional: append under "infra/meta-updates" when present.

Jordan Miles: Keep changelog terse. For meta-only tags add a one-line entry like "meta: pipeline artifact for config change (no behavior change)". Don't promote them to release notes main section.

Diego Alvarez: We should also update tooling: small script that canonicalizes tags for downstream consumers. Example behavior: `parse_semver()` should return semver core (1.12.3) and `buildmeta()` returns meta string; tools can opt to compare core-only or include buildmeta. I'll open a tiny PR to libs/semver-utils.

Lena Park: Ops questions: If downstream CI pins to full tag and we issue only meta tag, will their deployment pick it up?

ops-bot: if consumer pins full tag, they need the exact buildmeta value. releasebot can emit metadata-tag AND push a symbolic stable-ref like `latest-config-run-<YYYYMMDD>` if requested by consumer to ease pinning.

Jordan Miles: I'd rather avoid symbolic refs if possible. It hides provenance. Better to require the consumer to opt-in with `release: metadata-patch` so they get the explicit buildmeta tag.

Diego Alvarez: Action items: (1) Diego to add PR to releasebot to parse `release: metadata-patch` and emit buildmeta-only tag; (2) Jordan to update RELEASE_PROCESS.md with conventions; (3) Lena to hold off on merging more config flips until PR lands or add annotation to existing PR.

Lena Park: I'll annotate the open PR with `release: metadata-patch` as a stopgap. Thanks all.

Jordan Miles: One last example to include in docs:```
# no semver bump (preferred for config-only)
v1.12.3+meta.20260322T143001Z

# semver bump only for api/behavior change
v1.12.4
```

Diego Alvarez: Nice. I'll include a note about rollback: meta-only tags use same rollback window as patches and are eligible for auto-rollback by ops-bot unless explicitly excluded.

Lena Park: Great, closing thread — will follow up on the releasebot PR and the semver-utils patch. :rocket:
